dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: This crowded tavern is getting terribly stuffy... They should really open a window to let some fresh air in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Goodbye. I'll be leaving myself shortly... I left some herbs out to dry — I do hope Gui remembered to take them in...

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: It's just a game, so don't take it to heart. Take it from me — I'm a doctor. Excessive rumination on negative thoughts is known to cause many adverse health effects.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Card games do not appear to be my forte... Perhaps in the future, I should stick to medicine.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: As you wish. I am hardly an expert at this game, however, so please forgive me if my perfomance fails to live up to your expectations.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: That partly came down to luck... But I daresay I won't be needing your forgiveness today.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: *cough* ...I am defeated. That went much as I expected...

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Happy to oblige, but remember — everything in moderation, even card games. You might think of them as a fun way to relax, but they actually require substantial mental energy, so be sure to get adequate rest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Ah... Well, that was a stroke of good fortune... Though I couldn't help but notice you were visibly anxious during the game, which seemed to be affecting your concentration. It could simply be sleep deprivation, but are you experiencing any other symptoms?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: You beat me. *sigh*... I must say, I'm feeling a little faint after all that. A cup of strong tea should rejuvenate me, shall I make one for you, too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
